decision.reason: The first predeclared attempt was invalid before any answer or provider call because two concurrent cold reads OOM-killed HydraDB at its frozen 5.5 GiB limit. This contract reduces evaluation concurrency to one without changing the runtime image/config, retrieval semantics, population, models, thresholds, or scoring.
decision.noTuning: No retrieval, packing, prompt, model, threshold, or answer-selection change is permitted after this manifest is committed and before the qualification result is read.

invalidRunConditions: any pinned artifact, code, model, runtime, population, batching, or price identity differs
any counted pass records a live provider call or is not warm
any output is overwritten or any batch is selectively omitted
the provider-resolved judge model differs from gpt-4o-2024-08-06
retrieval, packing, prompt, model, threshold, or answer-selection code changes after this manifest is committed
the 60-row exact upstream rescores or the predeclared gate cannot be produced

authorization.scope: 60-question dev priming, counted qualification, and exact upstream rescoring of the frozen v1 and new v2 dev answer artifacts only; excludes the 104-question test arm

signOff.note: The maintainer approved the recommended D5 fresh-dev qualification and provider spend. This resource-safe retry remains within that scope and changes no semantic or acceptance setting.
